Harper (sec-eng): Noticing svc-mesh mTLS failures after RBAC change removing decrypt on rotator.
Noel (infra): sample error?
Harper (sec-eng): proxy log: 
```
2026-06-12T07:01:05Z proxy-eu tls: unwrap failed: KMS AccessDenied principal=role/rotator-role key=alias/region-keystore
```
Rina (sre): saw ~30s of 502s svc-gateway -> svc-api in eu-west-1. Canary affected first.
AuditBot: KMS-DENY-1799: 16 KMS:Decrypt DENY events for arn:aws:iam::111111:role/rotator-role between 2026-06-12T07:00:50Z and 2026-06-12T07:01:20Z. Logs: /logs/sec/kms/2026-06-12/1799.json
Noel (infra): Mitigation: apply infra patch to grant kms:Decrypt to service-account/proxy-fanout for alias/region-keystore for 20m via pipeline; bump proxy cache TTL to 4m on canary. No console edits.
PatchBot: Job j-999 started by Rina (sre). Command recorded.
Rina (sre): Patch applied to canary 1/5, cache TTL bumped. Error rate returned to baseline ~35s after.
Harper (sec-eng): Postmortem actions: 1) RBAC preflight to simulate KMS decrypt as rotator principal before rollout, 2) default proxy cache TTL -> 3m, 3) rotator fallback to cached chain + circuit-breaker on decrypt failure, 4) retain KMS deny logs 90d.
Noel (infra): I'll open infra PR for preflight and add an observability gate: fail canary if KMS Deny > 0 for 1m.
Rina (sre): Linking incident SEC-5100 once postmortem doc is up. Closing thread unless new alerts. :lock:
